items.name: CRISP controllers
items.what: Torque-based Cartesian impedance and operational-space controllers for ros2_control, with Python and Gymnasium layers, built to track learned policies and teleoperation.

items.name: ros2_impedance_controller
items.what: Cartesian impedance on ros2_control + Pinocchio: Hogan's law with optional inertia shaping, a PD version, an MPC version in development.

items.name: FZI cartesian_controllers
items.what: Cartesian motion, force and compliance controllers for ros2_control (Humble, Iron, Jazzy), on joint position or velocity interfaces.

items.name: franka_ros2 Cartesian impedance example
items.what: Franka's reference Cartesian impedance controller for the FR3 (jazzy branch).

items.name: MoveIt Pro admittance (JTAC)
items.what: MoveIt's compliance lives in MoveIt Pro: a joint-trajectory admittance controller and a hybrid velocity/force controller. MoveIt itself has no impedance controller; MoveIt Servo streams real-time targets.

items.name: joint_trajectory_controller
items.what: The reference JTC: interpolates joint waypoints; robot_controllers' JTC matches it tick for tick.

items.name: JTC PR #1306: sample at t + dT
items.what: Since Nov 2024 the JTC samples its command one control period ahead: the same idea as lookahead, for one period.

items.name: admittance_controller
items.what: Chainable admittance from a tool F/T sensor; the JTC can feed it.

items.name: Controller chaining
items.what: Cascaded controllers run in one cycle; our layout adds where each link of the chain physically runs.

items.name: moteus control modes
items.what: Position, velocity and torque modes; mjbots advises putting as much of the law as possible in the drive's position controller.

items.name: moteus theory of operation
items.what: The drive integrates its setpoint at the commanded velocity between frames: why the secant velocity matters.

items.name: Beckhoff TwinCAT: Dead time compensation
items.what: Drive and encoder dead-time compensation in the motion stack.

items.name: Tomizuka 1987, ZPETC
items.what: Using future reference samples to cancel tracking lag; lookahead is its pure-delay case.

items.name: Smith 1957, the Smith predictor
items.what: Delay inside a feedback loop needs prediction (Chem. Eng. Prog. 53(5):217; explainer link).

items.name: De Luca et al. 2006, collision detection on the DLR-III arm
items.what: The momentum-observer residual for collision detection and reaction.

items.name: Haddadin, De Luca, Albu-Schäffer 2017, Robot Collisions survey
items.what: Detection, isolation and identification of collisions.

items.name: Hogan 1985, Impedance Control
items.what: Control the relationship between motion and force.

items.name: Ott 2008, Cartesian Impedance Control
items.what: Redundant and flexible-joint robots.

items.name: Salisbury 1980, Active stiffness control
items.what: A Cartesian spring from joint servos: K_q = JᵀKJ.

items.name: Port-Hamiltonian impedance control benchmarking (ICAR 2025)
items.what: Passivity and fidelity metrics for grading impedance controllers.

items.name: Aljalbout et al. 2024, the role of the action space
items.what: 13 control spaces, 250+ agents, sim to real.

items.name: safe-control-gym
items.what: PID, LQR, MPC and RL under disturbances (cart-pole, quadrotor).
